gap_explanations.data: No licensed, de-identified held-out project/status/commitment/risk dataset, gold manifest or independently justified sample/group counts has been supplied. Synthetic test fixtures are contract evidence only.
gap_explanations.models: No real semantic or generation provider configuration, request payload evidence, usage receipt, price contract or repeated-run output has been supplied. A frozen not_used declaration is allowed only for a genuinely deterministic experiment arm; stubs do not establish real-model effects.
gap_explanations.judge: No frozen versioned semantic judge, deterministic checks, human review protocol or annotation evidence has been supplied.
gap_explanations.thresholds: Domain floors, allowed non-regression, error limits, latency/cost SLOs and calibration rationale remain unresolved. Design suggestions are not accepted measurements or automatically selected thresholds.
gap_explanations.statistics: The reusable grouped paired cluster-bootstrap calculation, frozen protocol binding and reproducible seeded synthetic comparisons are implemented and tested by A9. No independently approved real-experiment confidence level, sample sufficiency/calibration choice or real repeated comparison artifact has been supplied.
gap_explanations.execution: The frozen multi-arm A9 runner now executes actual SQLite question/refresh/model-cache integration with full-phase measurement contracts, unknown debt and isolated ablations. Real Ollama port plus host observer/tariff binding are implemented but not invoked against a real endpoint. The actual licensed workload, installed model identity, frozen independent judge/threshold/statistical choices, host telemetry/tariffs/invoices and repeated real baseline/candidate measurements remain absent.

accounting_contract.currency_unit: Integer microunits, one millionth of the declared currency; currencies cannot be combined without a separately frozen conversion experiment.
accounting_contract.phase_rule: Each unique accounting operation has exactly one phase. Phase coverage is explicit even when a measured phase performs no billable work. Missing phases are unknown, not zero.
accounting_contract.operation_identity: A stable operation ID identifies one possibly billable call/attempt. Retries and concurrent losers remain separate operations; duplicate budget-account constraints are not separate charges. Exact replays are idempotent and conflicting replays fail.
accounting_contract.all_request_denominator: Every request in the frozen workload, in workload order, including failures, refusals, reasonable unknowns, and diagnostic requests. No selective deletion of failures or low-utility requests.
accounting_contract.effective_answer_denominator: Non-diagnostic, answerable, correct answers with complete necessary evidence, preserved qualifiers, freshness and current safety. Reasonable unknown, incorrect answer/refusal and system error are separately labeled, never substituted for an effective factual answer. Zero effective answers yields an undefined per-effective-answer cost and cannot pass.
accounting_contract.shared_cost_allocation: Equal share among recorded triggering request IDs; setup/maintenance without triggering request IDs is allocated equally to all workload requests. Allocation is independent of answer correctness; the unique global ledger remains authoritative, including when there are no requests.
accounting_contract.resource_accounting: CPU milliseconds, I/O bytes, storage byte-seconds and network bytes remain separate measured counters. Monetary resource pricing requires an explicit tariff reference and is reported separately from provider-billed cost.
accounting_contract.unknown_cost: Unknown actual cost remains null even if an estimate or conservative reservation exists. A real zero provider bill needs an explicit receipt. Estimated tokens and money are kept separate from measured provider usage and bills.
accounting_contract.outstanding_debt: Fixed finite unexecuted responsibility IDs are recorded separately from dispatched unresolved calls. Their conservative bounds remain visible; any missing bound makes the debt upper bound unknown. Outstanding work or unresolved billing blocks cost acceptance rather than being released as zero.
accounting_contract.window_and_drain: The workload drain-policy hash binds injection cutoff, observation window and drain rules for every arm. Window and drain entries both remain in the global ledger. A fixed-window report includes remaining finite obligations; acceptance requires their completion and actual cost reconciliation.
accounting_contract.comparability: Bind identical event order, initial snapshot, request/change distribution, semantics, current security, hard budget, hardware, request manifest, judging groups, and drain policy. Candidate strategy/configuration is tracked separately; baseline and candidate report hashes bind the paired comparison.
accounting_contract.privacy: Use opaque experiment operation/request/group IDs and minimal references. Do not record source bodies, credentials, erased content or customer private identifiers in evaluation artifacts. This file is not a production trace or data-sharing authorization.
accounting_contract.model_call_binding: Each actual model call binds its semantic_model or generation_model role and frozen configuration hash. A not_used role cannot have recorded calls; each declared executed role requires matching call evidence. Legacy unbound calls remain reportable but cannot pass acceptance. These bindings check supplied records, not whether a provider actually executed.
accounting_contract.usage_reconciliation: An authoritative provider receipt may settle billing and measured tokens together or enrich unknown/estimated usage later while preserving the same bill and call identity. Exact replays do not duplicate usage or cost; conflicting measured usage or billing fails. An absent token receipt remains unknown.

acceptance_contract.freeze: Store the externally approved profile fingerprint before inspecting candidate results. Any profile mutation, including thresholds or judge configuration, requires a new evaluation.
acceptance_contract.required_quality: Effective answerable coverage, necessary evidence coverage, qualifier fidelity, error rate, latency, and permitted effective-rate regression are checked together with both cost denominators. Unsafe or stale delivery blocks the gate.
acceptance_contract.benefit: Require a strictly lower observed cost per effective answer and a grouped paired confidence interval whose upper cost-difference bound is below zero, while its lower effective-rate-difference bound satisfies the frozen non-regression rule.
acceptance_contract.scope: The evaluator accepts trusted annotated records and referenced comparison artifacts. Passing this cost/utility slice does not certify extraction/Recall@budget, operational release, actual provider execution, data license legality, backend durability or all 98 design scenarios. Existing evidence-quality and release gates remain necessary.
unsupported_claims: No production savings percentage or optimal scheduling threshold is claimed.
No runtime capability is enabled or advertised by this document.
No AM70-T13 completion, Q7-31 end-to-end completion or Q7-32 production acceptance is implied.
Historical 120-to-52 routing, 21.2% context and 150-refresh anecdotes are not baseline evidence.
